model: AquaForce 30XV 140-500 (Touch Pilot, 2017) native BACnet IP points
applies_to: Carrier AquaForce 30XV140-500 variable speed air-cooled screw chillers with the Touch Pilot display (original / Series A documentation, 2017).
summary: The older AquaForce 30XV with the Touch Pilot controller has a native BACnet IP object list: Analog Values for temperatures, pressures, capacity, drive frequencies, setpoints and configuration, Binary Values for status, inputs, outputs and one flag per alarm, and 50 Trend Log objects. Network commands use separate _wr objects (start/stop, occupancy, emergency stop, control point, demand limit, setpoint select).
notes: This is a different instance map from the later 30XV Series B (PIC6.1, form 30XV-6T); only a minority of objects match, so use the list for your controller generation.
Command objects marked CMD in the table are listed as commandable; other RW objects (setpoints, trend logs) as writable.
The table has no units column; units follow the controller unit setting.
The option column (COV, intrinsic reporting, trend log) is not reproduced.
Alarm BV descriptions are the alarm codes as printed. The separate BACnet/Modbus translator list (Appendix D of the same manual) is its own file.

source.title: AquaForce 30XV140-500 Variable Speed Air-Cooled Liquid Chillers - Controls, Start-Up, Operation, Service and Troubleshooting, Appendix E BACnet IP Points

integration.summary: Put the chiller in Network control, then command through the _wr objects: start/stop, occupancy, control point and demand limit. Read control type, run status, capacity, entering and leaving water temperatures and the alarm state.

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_CTRL_PNT_wr
minimum_points.why: Leaving water control point from the BMS

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_CTRL_TYP
minimum_points.why: Control type: Local, Network or Remote

integration.enable: Network control has to be selected on the chiller (machine control method) before the _wr commands take effect.
gotchas: Read-back and write objects are separate: write the _wr objects, read the matching status objects.
